# cheap-ruler fixtures

`lines.json` is a copy of `test/fixtures/lines.json` from
[cheap-ruler v4.1.1](https://github.com/mapbox/cheap-ruler/tree/v4.1.1). It
contains 58 lines of `[longitude, latitude]` points in degrees near Dallas,
Texas. cheap-ruler uses the ISC license. See `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`.
